editionLabel: English R&R Games two-player base-game rules, 2016 copyright
firstPlayerRule: The first player to say “Tut Tut” places the first block in the pyramid.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Players alternate placing their blocks. Once all 30 blocks are placed, they continue taking turns to remove blocks and form poker hands.
